# Tabulate data from sequenced isolates
```{r}
collapse_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(unique(na.omit(x)))
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(x, collapse = "; ")
}

ecoli_sp    <- "Escherichia coli"
ecoli_st131 <- "Escherichia coli ST 131"
ecoli_pg    <- "B2"

sequencing_summary <- df_index %>%
  group_by(household) %>%
  summarise(
    # Index (visit 0)
    no_index_isolate    = as.integer(!any(visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    index_species       = collapse_unique(Species[visit == 0]),
    index_species_ST    = collapse_unique(Species_ST[visit == 0]),
    ecoli_index         = as.integer(any(Species == ecoli_sp & visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ecoliST131_index    = as.integer(any(Species_ST == ecoli_st131 & visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Baseline (visit 1)
    no_baseline_isolate    = as.integer(!any(visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    baseline_species       = collapse_unique(Species[visit == 1]),
    baseline_species_ST    = collapse_unique(Species_ST[visit == 1]),
    ecoli_baseline     = as.integer(any(Species == ecoli_sp & visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ecoliST131_baseline    = as.integer(any(Species_ST == ecoli_st131 & visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Any visit
    all_species_ST      = collapse_unique(Species_ST),
    any_ecoliST131      = as.integer(any(Species_ST == ecoli_st131, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Index or baseline 
    ecoli_index_or_baseline      = as.integer(any(Species == ecoli_sp & visit %in% c(0, 1), na.rm = TRUE)),
    ecoliST131_index_or_baseline = as.integer(any(Species_ST == ecoli_st131 & visit %in% c(0, 1), na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Index-first, baseline fallback (strict)
    ecoli_index_or_baseline_strict = {
      has_index <- any(visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      as.integer(
        if (has_index) {
          any(Species == ecoli_sp & visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          any(Species == ecoli_sp & visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
    },
    ecoliST131_index_or_baseline_strict = {
      has_index <- any(visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      as.integer(
        if (has_index) {
          any(Species_ST == ecoli_st131 & visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          any(Species_ST == ecoli_st131 & visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
    },
    ecoliPG_index_or_baseline_strict = {
      has_index <- any(visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      as.integer(
        if (has_index) {
          any(Species == ecoli_sp & ecoli_phylogroup == ecoli_pg & visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          any(Species == ecoli_sp & ecoli_phylogroup == ecoli_pg & visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
    },

    # 3-category variables (index-first, baseline fallback)
    ecoli_ST131_cat = {
      v   <- if (any(visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) 0 else 1
      sel <- !is.na(visit) & visit == v
      if (!any(sel)) NA_character_
      else if (any(Species_ST[sel] == ecoli_st131, na.rm = TRUE)) "E. coli ST 131"
      else if (any(Species[sel] == ecoli_sp, na.rm = TRUE))       "E. coli non-ST131"
      else "Non-E. coli"
    },
    ecoli_PG_cat = {
      v   <- if (any(visit == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) 0 else 1
      sel <- !is.na(visit) & visit == v
      if (!any(sel)) NA_character_
      else if (any(Species[sel] == ecoli_sp & ecoli_phylogroup[sel] == ecoli_pg, na.rm = TRUE)) "E. coli B2"
      else if (any(Species[sel] == ecoli_sp, na.rm = TRUE))                                     "E. coli non-B2"
      else "Non-E. coli"
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ecoli_ST131_cat = factor(ecoli_ST131_cat, levels = c("E. coli ST 131", "E. coli non-ST131", "Non-E. coli")),
    ecoli_PG_cat    = factor(ecoli_PG_cat,    levels = c("E. coli B2", "E. coli non-B2", "Non-E. coli"))
  )
```

# Merge with clinical data and add fallback to HUP data
```{r}
clinical_prolonged_colonization <- clinical_raw %>%
  left_join(sequencing_summary %>% rename(household_number = household),
            by = "household_number") %>%
  mutate(
    has_index_wgs    = as.integer(no_index_isolate %in% 0),
    has_baseline_wgs = as.integer(no_baseline_isolate %in% 0),
    hup_ecoli        = case_when(
      is.na(hup_id)                             ~ NA_integer_,
      grepl("coli", hup_id, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 1L,
      TRUE                                      ~ 0L
    ))

for (v in c("ecoli_ST131_cat", "ecoli_PG_cat")) {
  x <- as.character(clinical_prolonged_colonization[[v]])
  clinical_prolonged_colonization[[v]] <- ifelse(
    is.na(x) & clinical_prolonged_colonization$hup_ecoli %in% 0,
    "Non-E. coli",
    x
  )
}
```

# Number of E. coli isolates with eligibile follow up
```{r}
no_index <- subset(clinical_prolonged_colonization,no_index_isolate==1 |is.na(no_index_isolate))

table(no_index$hup_id,no_index$ecoli_baseline,useNA = 'ifany')
```


# Prolonged colonization by organism
## Raw prolonged colonization data
```{r}
# Raw data
paste0("HUP data")
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$hup_id, useNA = "ifany")
paste0("HUP data by index WGS")
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$hup_id, useNA = "ifany",clinical_prolonged_colonization$index_species)
# Prolonged by status
paste0("Prolonged colonizatino by HUP")
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$prolonged_colonization, clinical_prolonged_colonization$hup_id, useNA = "ifany")
paste0("Prolonged colonizatino by E coli WGS index")
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$prolonged_colonization, clinical_prolonged_colonization$ecoli_index, useNA = "ifany") 
paste0("Prolonged colonizatino by E coli WGS index or baseline strict")
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$hup_id,clinical_prolonged_colonization$ecoli_index_or_baseline_strict, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Prolonged by phylogroup and ST131

Note: Excluded the non sequenced E coli subjects
```{r}
## Overall
# PG
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$prolonged_colonization, clinical_prolonged_colonization$ecoli_PG_cat)
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$prolonged_colonization, clinical_prolonged_colonization$ecoli_PG_cat) %>% fisher.test()

# ST131
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$prolonged_colonization, clinical_prolonged_colonization$ecoli_ST131_cat)
table(clinical_prolonged_colonization$prolonged_colonization, clinical_prolonged_colonization$ecoli_ST131_cat) %>% fisher.test()
```

## Prolonged by phylogroup and ST131 restricted to just E coli isolatse
```{r}
## Ecoli specific
ecoli_df <- clinical_prolonged_colonization %>% subset(ecoli_PG_cat != "Non-E. coli")
# PG
table(ecoli_df$prolonged_colonization, ecoli_df$ecoli_PG_cat)
table(ecoli_df$prolonged_colonization, ecoli_df$ecoli_PG_cat) %>% fisher.test()

# ST131
table(ecoli_df$prolonged_colonization, ecoli_df$ecoli_ST131_cat)
table(ecoli_df$prolonged_colonization, ecoli_df$ecoli_ST131_cat) %>% fisher.test()
```
